files.config.yaml:
listen: "127.0.0.1:0"
admin_listen: "127.0.0.1:0"
advanced:
  allow_destinations: ["127.0.0.1"]
store: {module: memory}
providers:
  mock:
    api_key: { env: MOCK_KEY }
models:
  test-model:
    provider: mock
mcp:
  canonical_uri: "http://127.0.0.1:18080/mcp"
  authorization_servers: ["https://login.example.com"]
plugins:
  enabled: true
  dir: '{plugins_dir}'
  trust:
    allow_unsigned: true
identity-providers:
  idp:
    module: e2e-idp-module
    settings:
{issuer_settings:6:http://127.0.0.1:18080/mcp}auth:
  chain: [idp]
  signing_key: { env: BUSBAR_SIGNING_KEY }
